Morning skincare routine that actually works — and yes, order matters more than you think. Here's the correct sequence to follow every single morning: ✔ Cleanser — skip it if your skin is very dry (over-cleansing is a real thing) ✔ Toner — preps and balances your skin ✔ Vitamin C serum — always apply this one first ✔ Hyaluronic acid serum — lock in that hydration on top ✔ Moisturizer — seal everything in ✔ Sunscreen — non-negotiable, every single day The reason Vitamin C goes before Hyaluronic acid? Vitamin C works best on clean, dry skin at a lower pH — applying it first means better absorption.  Hyaluronic acid then pulls moisture into the skin and keeps it there. Layering them in the right order = you actually get the benefits you're paying for. Most people either skip steps, use the wrong order, or pile everything on at once and wonder why their skin isn't improving.  A consistent, correctly ordered routine beats any expensive product used wrong. Save this so you never second-guess your morning routine again. 💛 #mythbusters #kbeauty #dryskin #skincaresteps #morningskincareroutine
